description: This source file defines the 'Operator' class, which models mathematical operators including their symbol, precedence, associativity, and number of operands. It manages a set of operators and validates their properties.

classes.name: Operator
classes.description: Represents a mathematical operator with properties like symbol, precedence, operand count, and associativity.

classes.name: Operator.Associativity
classes.description: Enumeration for operator associativity with values LEFT, RIGHT, and NONE.

methods.name: getSymbol
methods.description: Returns the symbol representing the operator.

methods.name: getOperandCount
methods.description: Returns the number of operands the operator takes.

methods.name: getAssociativity
methods.description: Returns the associativity of the operator.

methods.name: getPrecedence
methods.description: Returns the precedence level of the operator.
